notes.title: A Raven Monologue Patch 1.1 Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31444367/6d6c1661da9890dc991a2685b73f079af3878639.jpg[/img]

Good day, everyone!

First of all, thank you so much for your support for A Raven Monologue! We're so happy to see that many people love the game and show their support.

And here are some updates for Windows version.

[h1]Important Changes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Steam overlay is now working. Hurray!
[*]Steam screenshot shortcut is also working! Immortalize your best memories with Sir Raven!
[/olist]

Have a nice day!
